title: Every CLI failure prints one JSON error envelope on one stream
description: Consumer (Papyrus BiblicusRunner) found inconsistent failure output across JSON-emitting CLI commands. extract url-text prints UrlTextResponse status failed on stdout exit 1 for extraction failures but a status/error envelope on stderr exit 2 for input failures. validate_request ValueError prints bare text on stderr exit 2. extract web-metadata prints status/error on stderr. summarize map-reduce and extract article-text print TransformResult with error on stdout. context-pack build-blocks has no structured failure. Goal: one contract.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus/pull/82. Contract: every typed command (API_COMMANDS) prints exactly one CommandFailure JSON object {status: failed, error: {code, message, details}} on stdout, stderr empty. Exit 2 = rejected by validation (invalid_request, invalid_input_json, missing_source_uri, missing_input, invalid_input, input_too_large); exit 1 = operation failed. Non-typed commands and argparse usage errors unchanged. Python functions unchanged. Papyrus consumer change needed in biblicus_runner.
